**Findings for `discovery.3.retry`**

- **Context bloat (turns 3–143).** The session read about 140 turns of rules, specs and code before its first edit, which used 247,599 tokens. Context peaked at 353k and stayed over 200k for 182 turns. This is a retry with `prior_overlap` 1.0, so the attempt re-derived what the previous attempt had already established. The retry carried no compact summary of what to fix, which is likely why the exploration was so wide.
- **Tool thrash (turns 105–110, 41–46).** The same long-line grep was run on one file with thresholds of 300, 800, 1200, 1600, 150 and 500. Other length greps (turns 41–46) were repeated across files one at a time. A single targeted search would have done the job.
- **Tool thrash (turns 143–167, 173–175, 178–190, 212–233).** The edits were split into one sentence per call. There were 16 edits on one file in a row, then 3 more, and the hand-off was edited about 9 times. Batching or rewriting the block would have been cheaper.
- **Wasted turns (turns 256–280).** The session did a lot of polish after the blocker was already addressed. It reworded `RGN-AC16`, shortened `RGF-AC3` even though it noted that criteria have no length limit, and ran several flagged-phrase sweeps. It also re-read the whole hand-off twice (turns 236, 240).
- **Ambiguity in the retry brief (turns 2, 281).** The retry context names only `ts-dis-general` as a blocker. The session treated two checks as flagged and also reworked `ts-dis-behaviour` (`RGN-B13`, `RGN-AC13`). The retry brief may be incomplete or inconsistent. The intent also contains an unfilled placeholder (`⟨missing:settings.conversation⟩`), which suggests a settings problem.

**Conformance:** The header lists no prompt sections, lessons, skills or subagent types, so there is nothing to grade. The session did open all six rule files first (turns 3–8), as its own plan intended.

content.text:
The session closed the flagged checks, but it carried a very large context and spent several turns on probing searches. Some of that was forced by having no git.

- **Context size:** The session peaked at about 353k tokens, with 182 turns above 200k. About 248k tokens were spent before the first edit at turn 143, after reading the six rule files, hand-off, triage, specs and engine code. Six files were read again later. The long read-only phase (turns 3–141) is where most of the cost went.
- **Length probing:** Turns 105–110 ran the same line-length grep at thresholds 300, 800, 1200, 1600, 150 and 500. Turns 41–46 and 263–270 repeated the 500-character check across files. One pass with a single threshold would have covered it.
- **No git for restore:** The retry had to undo edits an earlier attempt made to existing specs (`CON-B7`, `BUD-B8`, `WFM-B11`, `SCF-B18`). With no shell or git, it searched for other copies of the original wording (turns 67–72, 192–194, 253–254) and restored the text by hand. The closing message also says the session could not run git, the structure check or the judge, so it never verified its own result.
- **Conformance:** The header lists no prompt sections, lessons, skills or subagent types, so there is nothing to grade. The digest shows no skills or subagents used.

```json
{"observations": [
{"category": "context_bloat", "turns": [3, 143], "remedy_class": "flow", "confidence": 0.6,
 "note": "About 248k tokens were read before the first edit and context peaked near 353k, so the retry should be handed a narrower reading list instead of re-reading all rule files, specs and engine code."},
{"category": "wasted_turns", "turns": [105, 106, 107, 108, 109, 110], "remedy_class": "tools", "confidence": 0.5,
 "note": "Six consecutive greps of the same pattern at different line-length thresholds were probing that one check could have settled."},
{"category": "wasted_turns", "turns": [41, 42, 45, 46, 263, 264, 269, 270], "remedy_class": "prompt", "confidence": 0.35,
 "note": "The 500-character line check was repeated across files and edit passes, where one scoped search at the end would do."},
{"category": "environment_fault", "turns": [70, 71, 72, 192, 193, 194, 253, 254], "remedy_class": "tools", "confidence": 0.4,
 "note": "With no git or shell the retry had to hunt for other copies of the original sentences to undo a prior attempt's edits to existing specs, and it could not run the structure check itself."}
], "conformance": [], "none_found": false}
```
